summary: No installer-harmful behavior observed in adyen-web-v6@0.0.0-stage
details: Package adyen-web-v6 version 0.0.0-stage contains two files and no detected install-time or import-time code that reads installer secrets, contacts external endpoints, drops or executes remote content, modifies the installer's filesystem outside its own directory, or opens a backdoor. The name resembles the Adyen web SDK family, but name resemblance alone is not a supply-chain threat and the shipped contents show no exfiltration, dropper, silent-relay, or persistence mechanism. The 0.0.0-stage version string and minimal file count are consistent with a placeholder or staging publication.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
